data.title: 能天使 · 苹果派出炉之后
data.description: 【能天使 · 苹果派出炉之后】烘焙间飘着苹果和肉桂的香气，穿着奶油色毛衣、百褶裙与苹果图案围裙的能天使站在操作台前。她戴好隔热手套，用双手把一盘刚出炉的苹果派稳稳放上冷却架，忍不住露出期待的笑容——「先等它凉一点！这次边缘烤得刚刚好！」
data.action: 戴着隔热手套，双手把烤盘放在台面的冷却架上
data.promptProse: Exusiai lowers a freshly baked apple pie onto the cooling rack with both oven-mitted hands, smiling in her cream sweater, pleated skirt and apple-print apron. The medium view keeps the waist-high worktop, tray and gloves together, with the oven farther back. Morning window light outlines the golden crust and rack wires; the oven's remaining glow warms the mitts and tray underside.
data.camera: medium shot, worktop at waist height with tray and gloved hands visible
